title: docs(pm): PM token discipline — seat-post throttling, targeted reads, dispatch-prompt slimming at net-zero lines
body:
Fixes #9201

Implements the eight approved items from the issue body verbatim (6 as approved, 2 in their corrected form), on top of the #9194 and #9197 texts already on main — items 2/3 cross-reference the existing flip-anchor / `mergeable_state` clauses in `landing-operations.md` instead of duplicating them, so that file is untouched.

## What landed, per item

1. **Seat-post throttling** — write-side refresh points = round boundaries (dispatch, shift-end, pause/handover); mid-round state carried by claim/ACCEPT comments. Principle in `SKILL.md` (座位贴协议), detail in `seat-post-protocol.md` (new 写侧刷新点 bullet; 班次叙事 bullet re-pointed at it). Write-read-back downgraded to **risk-targeted** in the SKILL.md label-discipline bullet: labels always read back, multi-seat-writable surfaces always (race protection, not only sanitizer), body/comments only when they carry angle brackets or HTML comments; `seat-post-protocol.md` states explicitly that the seat-post body is multi-seat-writable and therefore never downgraded.
2. **PR read discipline** — `platform-readings.md`: status verification via minimal fields (search/list + `fields`) or events; `mergeable_state` read once at the enqueue decision point; the query-and-wait double spend banned by pointing at the flip-anchor clause in `landing-operations.md` (no second copy).
3. **Gate reads, corrected form** — cheap aggregate (`blocked`/`dirty`) is negative screening only; the release verdict stays the gate-carrying job's conclusion, read by name, never the full table (full table only when locating by name fails). The existing "job conclusions, never aggregate status" reading is strengthened, not overturned. The corrected platform fact is recorded: a draft PR's `mergeable_state` is always `draft`, so the originally proposed draft+clean combination does not exist and was not adopted.
4. **Final-report dedup** — dispatch-prompt template sentence added in SKILL.md: dev final reports carry machine-checkable fields only (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed), no restating of the PR-body narrative.
5. **Dispatch-prompt slimming, tiered** — cut hook-enforced sections (worktree-first / never-stash) and os-dev.md generic sections (push retry, language, releases ban); card-class-specific constraints (ADR-class draft-only, tier derivation quote, ratchet live reading, paraphrase discipline) explicitly not cut.
6. **Bookkeeping** — landing ledger = the seat post's landing checklist, written per round; whole-repo cross-checks prefer `head:claude/` filtering (added to the follow-to-MERGED bullet).
7. **ACCEPT short format** — checklist verdicts + spot-check readings + deviations, argumentation pointing at the PR itself (判决 line).
8. **Patrol-shot short template** — idempotent opening + key criteria kept, everything else pointerized with the seat post as sole state source (timer-text discipline bullet).

The 不该省 list (full-thread reads before claim, race re-read, label read-back, landed-content probes, load-bearing-claim spot checks) is untouched.

## Growth guardrail (hard constraint from the card)

Instruction surface nets **0 lines** (git: 73 insertions, 73 deletions). Per file:

| file | before | after | ceiling |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` | 681 | 682 | 682 |
| `references/platform-readings.md` | 134 | 133 | 134 |
| `references/seat-post-protocol.md` | 101 | 101 | 101 |
| `references/landing-operations.md` | 82 (untouched) | 82 | 82 |

No ceiling raised; the ratchet script is untouched. Every addition was funded by rewriting existing prose into genuinely shorter versions (the read-back line, the gate-conclusion line, the patrol-shot line, the dispatch-prompt bullet, plus compressions inside the sections being edited: 收集 opening, 探活 list, 45-minute paragraph, cross-wall timer bullet, stale-premise parenthetical, hot-handover story, and five platform-readings facts) — never by re-wrapping unchanged text. No item was scope-cut or dropped; all eight fit inside net zero.

  - .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md ⇢ '.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**' — clause ① of the model-tiering ruling: a card editing the PM dispatch skill is fable-mandatory, references included — the skill is the lane's own operating protocol and a wrong edit propagates to every later dispatch
